company_news.headline: Netflix Wraps Upfront, Volume 'Nearly Doubled'
company_news.summary: Netflix says it has "nearly doubled our ad commitments this year." In a release, Netflix President of Advertising Amy Reinhard says this was in line with expectations. She did not provide specific details on volume or pricing gains.

company_news.headline: Down but Not Out: Analysts See 40% Upside in Netflix After the Slide
company_news.summary: Netflix has shed more than a third of its value in a year, yet analysts keep stacking up buy ratings with price targets that sit far above Wall Street consensus. The question is whether the sell-off exposed a genuine crack or handed patient investors a rare entry point into a cash machine with an ad business barely off the launch pad.

company_news.headline: Why Is Disney So Much Cheaper Than Netflix? This Is the Only Answer I Can Think Of.
company_news.summary: Disney looks like the value play with improving fundamentals, while Netflix remains the premium-priced choice for investors who want a cleaner, more predictable streaming growth story.

company_news.headline: Netflix, Amazon, Amcor And A Consumer Defensive Stock: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
company_news.summary: Bryn Talkington picks Netflix as her final trade on CNBC's Halftime Report. Amazon and Amcor were also discussed.

company_news.headline: Netflix Looks Attractive to Short-Put Players - a 2.0% One Month Income Yield
company_news.summary: Netflix stock looks attractive to value investors, especially to out-of-the-money (OTM) short-put investors. For example, a 2.0% yield for one month is available on a put option with a 5% lower strike price.

company_news.headline: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Netflix Stock Will Climb or Sink?
company_news.summary: Netflix's weak share price performance over the past year has done little to shake Wall Street's confidence, with analysts maintaining a moderately optimistic outlook on the company's future.

company_news.headline: Netflix (NFLX) Stock May Be 26% Undervalued Despite New Franchise Rights
company_news.summary: Netflix stock has had a strong run over the past three years, yet current checks still point to a discount, with both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples indicating the shares may be pricing in less than the modelled cash flows. Over the past 3 years, Netflix has returned about 71%, which puts the recent share price weakness into context as a pullback after a longer period of gains.
